title: Selling an Inherited Property in Pondicherry: Where to Start
description: Inherited a house or plot in Pondicherry and want to sell? The papers to sort first: legal heir proof, mutation, family consent and a clear title.
h1: Selling an inherited property in Pondicherry: the papers to sort first
lead: Inherited property is often the hardest to sell, not because buyers dislike it, but because the paperwork is incomplete. Sorting it first saves months.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: Buyers and their lawyers need to see that every legal heir is identified and agrees. Depending on the case, this means a will, a legal heir certificate or a succession document. A lawyer should tell you which applies to your family.

blocks.h: Get the records in your name
bullets: Transfer the revenue records (patta and similar) to the heirs
Pay any pending property tax and utility dues
Keep the original deeds of the person who passed away

paras: If there are several heirs, all of them usually need to sign the sale, or one needs a properly drawn authorisation. A disagreement found after an advance is paid can stop the sale. Settle it in writing early. If an heir lives abroad, see our note on [power of attorney](/guides/power-of-attorney-property-india-nri).
Once the title is clean the sale is like any other. Start with a [free valuation](/free-property-valuation), then look at [how we sell](/sell-property-pondicherry).

blocks.p: Tell us what you hold. We will say what is missing before you list.
